title: Beyond Accuracy: Counterfactual Fragility and Demographic Bias in Clinical Evaluation of LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Demographic stress-testing by prepending race indicators (White, Black, Hispanic) to clinical case vignettes, then comparing the model's answer stability, explanation semantic drift (EDD), and automated stereotype evidence flags against a no-demographic baseline.

Demographic stress-testing by prepending sex indicators (male, female) alongside race to clinical case vignettes, evaluating whether these prefixes alter the model's clinical answers, trigger explanation drift, or surface gender-based stereotype evidence.
